scope: Sampled collision-envelope clearances and unsupported-subtree static gravity moments.

unverified: Continuous paths and poses outside the declared Cartesian samples and selected geometry pairs.
Physical geometry and tolerances; mesh distances use convex hulls, not concave CAD surfaces.
A support-plane bound below the required clearance is incomplete unless another sample proves failure.
Ground reactions, balance, leg loads and locomotion; samples need not be stable or reachable.
Acceleration, impact, friction, springs, actuator thermal limits and fatigue.
Controller reachability: configured actuator force caps do not prove available drive torque.
Bearing radial/axial force ratings, load paths, mounting stiffness and material stresses.
Hardware evidence for all estimated masses, capacities and geometry.

coverage.distance_fallback: Positive convex support-plane gaps certify lower bounds when native distances conflict.
coverage.sampling: Deterministic Cartesian groups; unsampled joints reset to home for each group.

assumptions: Masses and component inertias are unweighed surrogates from components.json; actuator force caps are estimated simulation limits, not verified continuous-duty ratings.
The 2 mm clearance and 80% torque-use thresholds are fixed planning criteria, without a manufacturing tolerance, thermal, fatigue or dynamic-load qualification.
Bearing moment capacities are unknown. All six expression axes therefore have an incomplete bearing assessment regardless of their gravity torque margins.

The 729-pose expression grid samples each axis at its lower limit, midpoint and upper limit. Each of the 12 leg axes separately samples five evenly spaced angles with other axes at home. The home pose is additional; combined leg poses, leg/expression combinations and unsampled intermediate angles are outside this screen.
Gravity loads cover only the unsupported head, jaw, tail and arm subtrees. Leg ground reactions, balance, locomotion, impacts and acceleration require separate checks.
Direct geometry distances cover all 66 motor-case pairs, selected upper-body proxy pairs and every upper-body proxy against all motor cases, including parent-child and same-body motor pairs.

Collision proxies approximate occupied envelopes, including a solid torso ellipsoid without motor mounting cutouts. Reported conflicts need CAD review and are not qualified physical interferences; they are retained as failures of the declared proxy-clearance criterion.

Foot, thigh-link and shin-link geometry pairs, decorative meshes, electronic packing envelopes, wiring and assembly access are outside the selected pair coverage. Joint attachment proxies such as hip-pitch-case/thigh-link, knee-case/shin-link and thigh-link/shin-link intentionally meet at their pivots and require a more detailed joint model before clearance qualification.
Excluded pair torso_collision / neck_support_collision: Neck support is fixed to the torso.
Excluded pair torso_collision / tail_segment_0_collision: Tail root intersects its torso attachment.

Excluded pair left_jaw_rail_collision / right_jaw_rail_collision: Both rails belong to the same rigid jaw assembly.
Excluded pair tail_segment_0_collision / tail_segment_1_collision: These segments form one continuous rigid tail.
Excluded pair tail_segment_0_collision / tail_segment_2_collision: These segments form one continuous rigid tail.
